item.title: UNC women top Virginia Tech, reach ACC Tournament semifinals for record 30th time in program history
item.description: Lanie Grant scored 21 points and Nyla Harris notched a double-double with 19 points and 10 rebounds as North Carolina disposed of Virginia Tech in the quarterfinals of the Atlantic Coast Conference Women’s Tournament Friday night.

item.title: Faith and resilience: NC father, daughter return home with church group after harrowing experience in Jerusalem
item.description: A North Carolina father and daughter are back home after spending several days living in a bomb shelter in Jerusalem. Lexington native Chris Elliott and his daughter, Riley, are thankful to be back home.
